title: 川西大环线出发核对清单
prompt: 明天出发去川西大环线，需要准备什么？给我个核对清单
program:
root = Col([intro, card, note])
$group = "证件支付"
$checked = []
$showIncomplete = false

intro = Text("明天出发，按分组逐项核对；切换分组不会丢失勾选状态。", "sm", "muted")
note = Caption("清单不包含实时天气、道路开放与健康诊断；药品相关请提前咨询专业人士。")

card = Card([header, progress, groups, actions, groupTitleRow, listContent], "outline", 4, 3)

header = Col([Title("川西大环线行前核对清单", "md"), Caption("出发日期：" + tomorrow + "（明天） · 按分组逐项核对")], 1)

progress = Col([Row([Text("已完成 " + completedCount + "/" + totalCount, "sm", "ink", "medium"), Spacer(), Text(percent + "%", "md", "info", "semibold")], 2), progressTrack], 2)
progressTrack = Box([progressFill], "row", 0, 0, "surface", "full", false, "100%", 6)
progressFill = Box([], "row", 0, 0, "info", "full", false, percent + "%", 6)

groups = SegmentedControl($group, ["证件支付", "衣物装备", "健康准备", "车辆出行"], true)

actions = Row([Button($showIncomplete ? "显示全部" : "只看未完成", @Set($showIncomplete, !$showIncomplete), "ghost", null, "sm"), Spacer(), Button("重置勾选", @Reset($checked), "outline", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw")], 2)

groupTitleRow = Row([Text($group, "md", "ink", "semibold"), Spacer(), Text(@Count(groupItems) + " 项", "sm", "muted")], 2)

listContent = emptyIncomplete ? Text("本组已全部完成", "sm", "success") : checklist
emptyIncomplete = $showIncomplete && @Count(@Filter(groupItems, "checked", "==", false)) == 0
checklist = Col(@Each(visibleItems, "item", Pressable([Row([Icon(item.checked ? "check-circle" : "circle", "sm", item.checked ? "success" : "muted"), Text(item.text, "sm", item.checked ? "muted" : "ink")], 2)], @Set($checked, @Toggle($checked, item.id)), item.checked, 2)), 1)

visibleItems = $showIncomplete ? @Filter(groupItems, "checked", "==", false) : groupItems
groupItems = @Filter(items, "group", "==", $group)
items = @Each(checkItems, "i", {id: i.id, text: i.text, group: i.group, checked: @Includes($checked, i.id)})

completedCount = @Count(@Filter(items, "checked", "==", true))
totalCount = @Count(items)
percent = @Round(@Percent(completedCount, totalCount))

tomorrow = @AddDays(@Today(), 1)

checkItems = [{id: "id_card", text: "身份证原件", group: "证件支付"}, {id: "driving_licence", text: "驾驶证（若自驾）", group: "证件支付"}, {id: "bank_card", text: "银行卡与少量现金", group: "证件支付"}, {id: "bookings", text: "酒店、门票与预订信息", group: "证件支付"}, {id: "warm_layers", text: "保暖外套、抓绒或羽绒", group: "衣物装备"}, {id: "shoes", text: "防滑徒步鞋", group: "衣物装备"}, {id: "sun_protection", text: "遮阳帽、墨镜、防晒霜", group: "衣物装备"}, {id: "rain_gear", text: "雨衣或雨伞", group: "衣物装备"}, {id: "water_bottle", text: "保温杯或水袋", group: "衣物装备"}, {id: "power_bank", text: "充电宝与车载充电器", group: "衣物装备"}, {id: "health_check", text: "出发前确认身体状况", group: "健康准备"}, {id: "personal_med", text: "个人常用药与病历摘要（如有）", group: "健康准备"}, {id: "first_aid", text: "急救包、创可贴、体温计", group: "健康准备"}, {id: "lip_balm", text: "润唇膏、保湿用品", group: "健康准备"}, {id: "oxygen", text: "便携供氧设备（如适用，按说明使用）", group: "健康准备"}, {id: "car_check", text: "车况检查：轮胎、刹车、油液", group: "车辆出行"}, {id: "spare_tire", text: "备胎与换胎工具", group: "车辆出行"}, {id: "chains", text: "防滑链（视季节与路况而定）", group: "车辆出行"}, {id: "car_doc", text: "行驶证与保险单放在车内", group: "车辆出行"}, {id: "offline_map", text: "离线地图与导航路线下载", group: "车辆出行"}, {id: "emergency_kit", text: "应急三角警示牌与反光背心", group: "车辆出行"}]
